text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC). The combination of significant ALP and bilirubin elevation, elevated AST/ALT, and ultrasound findings of a thin-walled gallbladder with no stones in a 65-year-old female (assuming patient is female based on PBC demographics and context clues) points toward an autoimmune cholestatic disorder. I will ask you to confirm if you have experienced generalized itching or fatigue worsening at night, which are classic early symptoms, before proceeding to serology for anti-mitochondrial antibodies (AMA).
